body:
Server side of the ledger design (T-239): see the design of record, sections 1, 2 and 6.

* `sync._validate_expense`: the `type` key (default expense; absent OK; anything else incl.
  explicit null and wrong case is `invalid_expense` with row_id and field); transfer shape (one
  sender, one recipient, different accounts). `_encode_expense` stores `type` normalised. Rows
  written before this change are served with `"type": "expense"` added on read.
* `closing.expense_amounts` takes the type (income negated) and the freeze check treats a type
  change as changing every involved account (design section 2, "The freeze").
* Protocol: this is protocol 3, but the version gate itself is T-243; do NOT touch the gate here.
* Docs: docs/wire-contract.md "Expenses" section rewritten for the three types (and the
  error-table text for `invalid_expense`), server/README.md "Expenses lists" section renamed to
  Ledgers and updated, schema.sql comment on `items.expense`. READMEs describe current behaviour
  only, no ticket numbers or history.
* No schema change, no migration.

Tests (server/tests): parametrised validation over the three types (every accepted and every
refused shape, including transfer with 2 senders / 2 recipients / same account / mismatched
sums, wrong-case and null type, type on a non-ledger list still refused); LWW with the type as
part of the single expense field (a stale write that loses is discarded silently, as before;
shape errors still refused even when stale); legacy row without `type` read back with
type=expense (insert it directly into the DB); a full /sync round trip where one member pushes
one entry of each type and another member's delta returns them; the freeze matrix (voter and
former member involved in: create/edit/delete of each type, expense->income sign flip,
expense<->transfer type-only change refused when a frozen account is involved and allowed when
not, income creation involving a voter, a non-voter editing an entry that involves nobody
frozen); closing/unanimity regression. Each new test must fail when its change is reverted.
title: Ledger server: expense, income and transfer entry types, type-aware freeze
